note: The demo catalog fixtures every example hardcodes, and the semantic invariants ci/check-fixtures.mjs asserts before the browser sweep runs. Verified against https://demo.getgeolens.com/api on 2026-08-18, GeoLens 1.14.0. A tile probe names one z/x/y inside that dataset's footprint: Manhattan for the subway lines, the Matterhorn summit for the DEM. `grep` is the substring that finds this fixture everywhere it is written down in this repo. `computedFrom` records the page layout a bbox was derived from, since a change to that layout moves the box the page requests.
